nights.title: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour
nights.name: Olivia Rodrigo
nights.extract: Olivia Isabel Rodrigo is an American singer-songwriter and actress. Rodrigo began her career as a child actress, appearing in commercials and the direct-to-video film An American Girl: Grace Stirs Up Success (2015). She rose to prominence with her leading roles in the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark (2016–2019) and the Disney+ series High School Musical: The Musical: The Series (2019–2022).

de.who: Olivia Isabel Rodrigo ist eine amerikanische Singer-Songwriterin und Schauspielerin. Sie begann ihre Karriere als Kinderdarstellerin in Werbespots und dem direkt auf Video veröffentlichten Film An American Girl: Grace Stirs Up Success (2015). Bekannt wurde sie durch Hauptrollen in der Disney-Channel-Serie Bizaardvark (2016–2019) und der Disney+-Serie High School Musical: The Musical: The Series (2019–2022).

tr.who: Olivia Isabel Rodrigo, amerikalı bir şarkıcı-söz yazarı ve oyuncudur. Kariyerine reklamlarda ve doğrudan video olarak yayımlanan An American Girl: Grace Stirs Up Success (2015) filminde çocuk oyuncu olarak başladı. Disney Channel dizisi Bizaardvark (2016–2019) ve Disney+ dizisi High School Musical: The Musical: The Series'deki (2019–2022) başrolleriyle ön plana çıktı.
facts: Rodrigo, reklamlarda ve doğrudan video olarak çıkan An American Girl: Grace Stirs Up Success (2015) filminde çocuk oyuncu olarak kariyerine başladı.
